about_the_game:
Deus Mantle is a progression-based survival sandbox, where you find yourself exploring infinite procedurely-generated worlds full of danger and mystery.

Get prepared to face dangerous creatures to fulfill the will of the gods, and through these hardships you may just find your way home.

Exploration, World Generation

Every biome has unique materials you can gather and unique challenges to overcome!

Find tasty chilli peppers in Sandy Desert, dig up snowballs in Snowy Forest and get lost in Deep Forest looking for those precious berries.

Progression, Technologies, Crafting

Advance through technology tree, unlocking different items, buildings and game mechanics.

From zero to building magical factories to make materials, so you can enchant those materials to make materials faster!

Base building + Farming

Use all the materials you found to build your own base the way you want it.

Decorate your home with furniture, optimize how you make materials with automation and don't forget to water your crops!

Combat, effects, enemies

Slash enemies with the equipment you built, or combo-wombo your way through them with elemental magic.

Prepare yourself to challenge difficult bosses to get unique rewards.
